exposure: peripheral blood levels of direct bilirubin (DBIL)
cohort: The study included 471 pregnant women with chronic hypertension admitted to the Tongzhou Maternal and Child Health Care Hospital of Beijing between January 2020 and December 2023, categorized into superimposed preeclampsia and non-preeclampsia groups.
finding: A prediction model combining peripheral blood levels of direct bilirubin, gamma-glutamyl transferase, glucose, cystatin-C, and pre-pregnancy BMI demonstrated high predictive efficacy for superimposed preeclampsia in women with chronic hypertension.
